en-US.longDescription:
cv4pve-metrics-exporter is a Prometheus metrics exporter for Proxmox VE that provides
comprehensive monitoring data for your virtualization infrastructure.

Features:
- Prometheus metrics export for monitoring and alerting
- Node health and status metrics
- VM/Container resource usage and performance metrics
- Storage capacity and usage metrics
- Replication status monitoring
- High Availability (HA) resource tracking
- Subscription status monitoring
- Disk SMART health monitoring
- Customizable endpoint (host, port, URL path)
- API token support for secure authentication
- Multiple host support for HA configurations
en-US.name: cv4pve-metrics-exporter
